title: Yeasty, Crispy Mediterranean Chicken Skewers
description: A delicious and crispy Mediterranean dish perfect for a date night. Features frozen peas and is diabetic-friendly.
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together yogurt, olive oil, garlic, parsley, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the skewers in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.
While the skewers are baking, heat the balsamic glaze in a small saucepan over medium heat.
After 10 minutes of baking, remove the skewers from the oven and brush with the balsamic glaze.
Return the skewers to the oven and bake for an additional 5-7 minutes.
During the last 2 minutes of baking, add the frozen peas to the baking sheet with the skewers.
Remove the skewers and peas from the oven and let them rest for a few minutes.
Serve the skewers with crusty bread and additional balsamic glaze, if desired.
